title: Insurance Act
source_id: C.S.Nu., c.I-40 (originating as R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.I-4, duplicated for Nunavut)
verified_how: Register page 'INSURANCE ACT, Official Consolidation of', listed under I, legal notice last updated 03 July 2025. The notice PDF (NoticeCSNucI-40E.pdf) is headed 'Insurance Act / C.S.Nu.,c.I-40 / Notice under subsection 65(2) of the Legislation Act' and records changes 'made in the July 3, 2025 consolidation' (including replacing 'the Territories' with 'Nunavut' in the definitions in s. 1(1), a tell-tale of the carried-over origin). The consolidation PDF's cover prints 'OFFICIAL CONSOLIDATION OF INSURANCE ACT / C.S.Nu.,c.I-40 / (Consolidation date: July 3, 2025) / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.I-4'. In force; not repealed. Currency caveat on the Act's page: 'This consolidation is not up to date. See subsequent amendments: S.Nu. 2025,c.23,s.35 and S.Nu. 2026,c.7,s.9.'
notes: Carried-over NWT statute (R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.I-4), duplicated for Nunavut under the Nunavut Act and since amended by Nunavut. Statutory conditions, proof of loss, claims payment and insurer licensing. Work injury compensation is separate (Workers' Compensation Act; note that the register's letter-W listing could not be retrieved - see access_notes - so that Act was not verified).
